text:
Priya: hey, I accepted the org invite but when I try to clone repo 'infra-internal' I get 404. GitHub shows me as member though. Any ideas?
Olivia (DevEx): welcome! do you see the repo in the org web UI? are you using the correct account? :wave:
Priya: i can see my membership under https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/people but the repo list doesn't show private ones, says 'not found' when cloning over https.
Chris M: did you join the correct team? infra repo is restricted to 'eng-infra' team.
Priya: i thought invite put me in that team automatically?
Samir (IT): sometimes SSO provisioning doesn't add team membership. can you DM me your github username so i can check? also, did you enable 2FA? org requires it.
Priya: github username is priya-r. 2FA is on via app, shows enabled in profile.
Samir (IT): ok on our side i don't see you on eng-infra team. Olivia can resend invite to ensure team mapping.
Olivia (DevEx): resend incoming — @invite-bot re-send for priya-r to eng-infra
invite-bot: invitation re-sent to priya-r@users.noreply.github.com for team eng-infra (link expires in 7 days)
Priya: got email, clicked accept, web says 'You're already a member of Redwood Inference' but repo still 404 when cloning.
Chris M: try `gh auth status` and `git config --global user.name` to confirm which account gh/git are using.
Priya: ran `gh auth status` -> shows Logged in to github.com as priya-r (github.com) 
Priya: trying `ssh -T git@github.com` gives 'Permission denied (publickey)'
Samir (IT): ah—SSH key not set/added. our cloning over ssh will fail. Either switch to https with token or add your SSH key to GitHub. steps: generate key with `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "priya-r@redwood.com"`, then add to GitHub Settings > SSH and GPG keys.
Priya: ok adding now. thx. if that doesn't work, i will ping again. thanks everyone :heart:
Olivia (DevEx): looping back: once you can clone, we still need to confirm team membership for repo permissions. Samir will add you to eng-infra team after verification.
Samir (IT): done — added priya-r to eng-infra. you should have access in ~30s, let us know.
Priya: confirmed! can clone and see repo. super smooth, ty all :tada:
Chris M: welcome aboard :party_parrot:
Olivia (DevEx): adding a checklist to onboarding doc to avoid this: 2FA + SSH key + confirm team mapping. PR incoming. :memo:
